Given your enjoyment of creating custom maps in games and your preference for swimming laps for fitness, here are a few ideas to help break the "one more round" loop and ease any restlessness afterward:

**In-the-Moment Breaks:**

*   **Map-Building Interlude:** When you feel the urge for "just one more round," pause and dedicate 15-20 minutes to a small, focused task in your custom map editor. Shifting to a different creative outlet within the gaming space can disrupt the momentum of continuous gameplay.
*   **Lap-Based Timer:** Set a timer for a specific number of laps in the pool (e.g., 8-10 laps). Tell yourself you'll return to your game *after* completing those laps. The physical activity will help reset your body and mind.
*   **Active Transition:** Before resuming your game, do a quick, 5-minute swim focusing on a different stroke or a light, easy pace. This active transition can be more effective than simply stopping abruptly.

**Post-Gaming Wind-Down:**

*   **Cool-Down Swim:** After a longer gaming session, prioritize a 20-30 minute swim at a relaxed pace. Focus on deep breathing and gentle movements to counteract any physical restlessness.
*   **Map Review & Stretch:** Instead of immediately jumping back into gameplay, spend 10 minutes reviewing your custom map progress and then do some light stretching exercises. This combines a mental and physical reset.
